answerer_note: verdicts measure retrieval sufficiency: the retrieved context IS the response, so a verdict is the arm's accuracy ceiling. grade.md §8.
question_set_note: BURNED HELD-OUT SET: clean for exactly one run. Its six failures were then read and when.ts and terms.ts were built from two of them, so it is now as contaminated as the tuned set and is reported as a middle rung, not as the verdict.
query_regime_note: query terms lifted from the question text only. The questions paraphrase deliberately, so this is the hard regime and it is the realistic one.

corpus.compaction_summary_dependency: none — HELDOUT.md §2 asserts every H question's source record survives corpus.mts's filter (isCompactSummary included) and every expect token appears in it

questions.temporal_note: a calendar date, a clock time or a part of the day, by regex over the question text alone. Reproduces THIRD.md's published 30 / 16 / 30.

lost: H16:wrong(forget 32 users|single user|you lost the game)
H36:wrong(adding a rule doesn't fix it|doesn't read it at all)

without_window.method: window-tier rows deleted from the same responses and re-graded; the server has no flag to disable the tier, so the window FILTER is still in force and this is an upper bound

missing: adding a rule doesn't fix it
